provenance.notes: Read on 2026-11-10: the DILA's CGU of the Légifrance API on PISTE (CGU JO V1.1, 04/08/2020). §IV.3: quotas per second / minute / day, on the number of requests or the bandwidth, for the whole application or one method, shown only in the PISTE application's 'Consulter les quotas', changeable at any time: no public figure, so null. Access needs a PISTE account, the API's CGU accepted, and OAuth 2.0 credentials. §VI.2: the Licence Ouverte Etalab 2.0 allows commercial use, at the user's own risk (no guarantee of reliability or availability); the data are not authentic (only the signed PDF of the Journal officiel is). The licence asks to name the source and the date of last update; the credit text is this policy's wording, not the DILA's.
